[[File:Knightfall1.png|thumb|right|250px|Sculptures of the Four Masters were carved into the massive pylons of the Jedi Temple.]]
The '''Four Masters''' were four [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who founded the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4,000 years]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The Four Masters constructed a new [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[temple]]&mdash;replacing the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|one]] lost in the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|devastation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]&mdash;around a natural spire rising from the [[City/Legends|cityscape]] of the planet Coruscant. The building grew over the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] into a large complex that served as the central headquarters of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

Sculptures of these individuals were rendered as bas-reliefs into massive pylons which were displayed at the formal entrance to the Temple beyond the statues of two [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Warrior Masters]] and two [[Jedi Consular|Sage Masters]]. The [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]], leading through the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] to the main stair, terminated under these great pylons.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations" />

The statues of the Four Masters were destroyed or toppled in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
